Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 14-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JIPMER Senior Health Economist recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the JIPMER Senior Health Economist position is 14th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Senior Health Economist post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Health Economist position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 1,23,000/- plus HRA, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: For medical candidates, a Post Graduate Degree (MD/MS/DNB/MPH) after MBBS with 3 years of research experience is required. For non-medical candidates, a Doctorate (Ph.D.) in a relevant subject with 3 years of research experience is necessary.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this JIPMER Senior Health Economist recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Senior Health Economist position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Senior Health Economist post is 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the JIPMER Senior Health Economist job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete application along with required documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Senior Health Economist in this JIPMER recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Health Economist position at JIPMER will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Senior Health Economist position is Contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.
